data.rule: Score = Freshness 3 × (halves every 8 h) + Coverage 1.5 × log₂(1 + independent publishers) + Followed topics 2 × matches (up to 2) + Publisher preference 1 × (+1 preferred, −1 shown less) + section interest ± 1.5 + 0.2 with an image + Unseen 0.5. Syndicated copies and several feeds from one site count as one publisher.
data.keepLine: 0 articles kept. Saved articles are always kept. Older or surplus articles are dropped on the next refresh or Apply.

props.content: News Desk ranks with fixed, visible rules and no model. Every choice here says what it changes; open any story to see its score broken down.

props.title: Sections
props.description: More adds 1.5 to every story in a section, Less subtracts 1.5, Off hides the section everywhere. Followed topics live under Following.
